Record a Placido-ring eye video to measure tear-film stability with DEDector.
Capture a short Placido-ring video for Non-Invasive Break-Up Time testing.

1. Attach the Placido ring and turn on its light.
2. Select the eye being recorded.
3. Centre the reflected rings and keep them sharp.
4. Ask the person to blink once, then comfortably keep the eye open.
5. Record for up to 15 seconds. Stop immediately if uncomfortable.
Video captured and ready to share for hardware validation.

Capture or choose one clear, close-up photo of the eye.
Keep the full coloured iris and white of the eye visible. Use bright, even light, hold the phone level and make sure the image is sharp.
Grad-CAM influence heatmap over the processed eye photograph
Warm colours show regions influencing the model score. This is not a lesion boundary or diagnosis.
